Question Choices: There are 4 groups of 5 cats. How many cats are there in total? 5 + 5 + 5 + 5 = __
Hints: Think of adding 5 four times. You can also skip-count 5, 10, 15, 20.
Solution: Four groups of five cats give 5+5+5+5 = 20 cats.

Question Choices: Fill: There are 8 in each group and 3 groups. Write number of groups first: Total = __ x __
Hints: number of groups x size of group
Solution: There are 3 groups with 8 in each. Write number of groups first: 3 x 8. Fill 3, 8; the total is 24.

Question Choices: Select the repeated addition showing 3 groups of 6, with one addend per group. A) 3 + 3 + 3 B) 6 + 6 + 6 C) 6 + 6 + 6 + 6 ~~A | B | C~~
Hints: 3 groups of 6 means three 6s added together.
Solution: Three groups of six mean three addends of six: 6+6+6. That is B. A totals 9 and C totals 24.
